intent: Create one direct 3x3 contact sheet containing exactly nine consecutive 21:9 live-action film frames for the story The Missed Last Ferry. Read left to right, top to bottom. Each cell shows one new causal beat, not nine variations of the same pose.

inputs.description: Continuity master for sibling identities, navy and moss-green rainwear, burgundy scarf, dark backpack, scratched vermilion suitcase, pharmacy-left/ferry-right geography, flood depth, rain and cold-right/warm-left light.

tone_locks: cold predawn plus one amber practical

lighting.summary: continuous cold predawn sky from frame-right and one amber emergency lamp above the pharmacy on frame-left
lighting.narrative_function: cold ferry route opposes the warm rescue threshold
lighting.contrast: open wet shadows and protected faces

style.realism: natural people, rain, floodwater, wet stone and physically plausible interaction

continuity_locks: Lin Mei: short wet hair, long navy raincoat, burgundy scarf
Lin Jun: short hair, moss-green short jacket, dark backpack
one vermilion suitcase, black handle, two lower-right scratches
elderly pharmacist wears one yellow hooded raincoat and does not appear fully before frame 7
pharmacy shutter and amber lamp stay left; ferry dock stays right
mid-calf water, diagonal rain, cold-right and amber-left light
escape direction left-to-right for frames 1-8; only frame 9 reverses right-to-left after the decision
suitcase is pulled in frames 1-4, becomes the shutter support in frame 5, and remains wedged in frames 6-9

reference_assignments.use: preserve faces, body proportions, clothing, backpack, suitcase, geography, flood depth and light direction
reference_assignments.ignore: exact pose, crop, shot size and action; each frame card owns those

frames.story_moment: the siblings must reach the last ferry through the flooded street
frames.primary_action: Lin Jun pulls the vermilion suitcase while Lin Mei follows from pharmacy-left toward ferry-right
frames.camera_height: standing eye level across the street
frames.composition: pharmacy shutter and lamp anchor left, siblings and suitcase cross the midground left-to-right, lit ferry waits far right; readable water depth and empty route

frames.story_moment: time pressure rises but Lin Mei hears something behind them
frames.primary_action: both wade faster; Lin Mei turns her head back to pharmacy-left while Lin Jun and suitcase continue right
frames.composition: diagonal rain and suitcase wake preserve left-to-right movement; siblings remain separated enough to read opposing attention

frames.story_moment: the trapped pharmacist appears only through one hand under the shutter
frames.primary_action: an older yellow-sleeved hand reaches through the narrow pharmacy-shutter gap as the suitcase wheel passes in foreground water
frames.composition: only the older hand, yellow sleeve, metal gap, rainwater and recognizable suitcase wheel; no full pharmacist and no faces

frames.story_moment: the siblings split over whether to stop
frames.primary_action: Lin Mei stops at pharmacy-left while Lin Jun two steps to the right turns back; the extended suitcase handle creates a taut line between them
frames.composition: Lin Mei left under amber lamp, Lin Jun right in cold light, suitcase between; ferry remains small and urgent in far-right background

frames.story_moment: the escape asset becomes a rescue tool
frames.primary_action: Lin Mei kneels and slides the suitcase horizontally under the shutter so its hard shell becomes a support
frames.composition: clear suitcase-to-metal contact, her two hands on safe surfaces, aligned wrists and planted knee; Lin Jun begins returning in background

frames.story_moment: the siblings combine forces to raise the shutter
frames.primary_action: Lin Jun lifts the shutter with both hands while Lin Mei braces the suitcase and pushes upward from below
frames.composition: shoulders, wrists, planted feet and knees show load paths; water displacement and bending metal show counterforce; decisive opening remains visible

frames.story_moment: the rescue succeeds without releasing the support
frames.primary_action: the elderly pharmacist in a yellow hooded raincoat moves through the triangular opening; Lin Mei supports her forearm while Lin Jun continues bearing the shutter
frames.composition: one readable support contact per person, pharmacist clear of the suitcase edge, wedged suitcase and shutter geometry remain visible; no duplicated hands

frames.story_moment: the cost of the rescue arrives as the ferry departs
frames.primary_action: the three huddle under the awning while the siblings look past the pharmacist toward the leaving ferry
frames.camera_height: seated eye level under the awning
frames.composition: siblings and yellow-raincoat pharmacist compressed in left-midground, wedged red suitcase lower-left, ferry pulling away in right background; distance proves the missed departure

frames.story_moment: the siblings choose to return to the city with the rescued elderly pharmacist
frames.primary_action: Lin Mei and Lin Jun support the elderly pharmacist right-to-left through floodwater, leaving the suitcase wedged under the pharmacy shutter
frames.camera_height: standing eye level from the ferry-route side
frames.composition: motivated direction reversal: three figures walk left into the city; pharmacy and red suitcase remain right-rear, ferry is only a distant point of light; generous quiet water closes the story

must_preserve: exact 3x3 equal-cell layout and left-to-right top-to-bottom story order
master-reference identities, wardrobe, suitcase and geography
elderly pharmacist only as a hand in frame 3 and fully from frame 7
suitcase state, rain, flood depth and light continuity

quality_controls: thin consistent dark gutters between nine equal cells
